projects.name: Bagdad expansion
projects.quote: Current estimates, which remain under review, indicate future incremental capital costs for a new concentrator, mining equipment and expanded infrastructure to approximate $4.5 billion.

projects.name: El Abra expansion
projects.quote: Preliminary estimates, which remain under review, indicate project capital costs of approximately $7.5 billion (based on estimates prepared in 2024) with project economics supported using an incentive copper price of less than $4.00 per pound.
